remarks: Escape to your own private 23-acre retreat, perfectly set up for hunting season and year -round enjoyment. This unique property features a cozy Amish built cabin complete with a functional kitchen, beautiful custom black walnut cupboards, a relaxing loft area and a wood stove to keep you warm on those crisp evenings. The property is fully equipped with electric service already run to all structures, providing modern convenience in a rustic setting. Additional infrastructure includes a dedicated camper for visitors, an outbuilding for all the toys and a private privy building. Whether you are looking for a prime hunting camp or a peaceful getaway, this turnkey recreational parcel offers everything you need to start enjoying the outdoors immediately!
